scope: aggregate evaluation metrics only; no audio paths, transcripts, or predictions

validation_prefix_beam_width_10.note: Predictions were punctuation/whitespace only; lower CER did not indicate word recognition.

legacy_checkpoint_test.note: This is an older checkpoint evaluated before dataset expansion, not the 75-token continuation.

pretrained_whisper_small.note: Individual validation observations, not overall accuracy. The rerun used the same Whisper small model and sampling can vary.

limitations: One validation and one test sample per language cannot establish generalization.
Twenty-eight training recordings provide limited speaker, accent, vocabulary, and acoustic diversity.
Whisper small comparison CER can exceed 100 percent when insertions are present.
